defaults.name: Owl Falls

defaults.name: Cliffside Gallery
defaults.log: Matthael and Snaek reached the waterfall grotto seeking magical mushrooms. Met Eleanor (Ravenclaw, seventh year) and Benjamin (Hufflepuff); Ben sampled residue on his shears and became disoriented. Matthael levitated mushrooms to harvest silver pollen (Control d20 5, Effect d8 4, Strain d6 4): partial harvest, airborne exposure, altered perception. A moss-and-stone guardian awoke and demanded the pollen back. Matthael hugged and kissed the guardian, then returned all four harvested units. The guardian restored the mushroom beds and gifted one Silvercap, asking them to leave. Matthael departed for the nearest Floo Flame to travel to the Hogwarts greenhouses, still dizzy and holding the specimen in parchment.
defaults.there: Waterfall-side cliff gallery and sheltered mushroom grotto; magical purple mushrooms with silver pollen; moss-and-stone guardian (peaceful after pollen returned). Eleanor and Benjamin were present during encounter.
defaults.reward: Guardian’s Silvercap ×1 (gift; cultivation and properties unknown). Harvested silver pollen ×4 was returned to guardian; none retained.
defaults.hint: High stone walls rise above the falls.
defaults.notes: ENCOUNTER CLEARED, not a Lost Years main-plot quest. Guardian requested no more harvesting and told group to leave. Matthael has inhaled pollen and is still disoriented; Snaek unaffected. Next location: Hogwarts greenhouses via nearest Floo Flame. Other numbered POIs unchanged. The separate cow/transfiguration-box incident by the lakeside is not part of original #5 Lakeside Boathouse.

defaults.name: Lakeside Boathouse
defaults.log: From the south shore, Matthael used a small boat to carry his things toward Fir Isle.
defaults.there: Lakeside boathouse, shoreline, and access to a small boat.
defaults.reward: Boat available for the lake crossing.
defaults.hint: A boathouse stands on the near shore.
defaults.notes: Not CLEARED: this is a travel hub.

defaults.name: Fir Isle
defaults.log: Matthael swam from Hogwarts toward the island, levitated into the boat, landed here with Snaek, and opened an old case without checking for traps. An E. Vale note (1887) described an anchored-object compass. A black-glass vial released silver vapour and revealed a threshold leading to a stone chamber. Inside, Revelio revealed a hidden drawer and the phrase “AN ANCHOR IS NOT A PLACE. IT IS A THING THAT REMEMBERS WHERE IT BELONGS.” Wet bare footprints lead from the workbench toward the entrance. The drawer clicked unlocked.
defaults.there: Fir trees and an old wooden case. Found: black-glass vial (uncorked), brass compass pointing to an anchored object, folded note signed E. Vale, three corroded silver sickles, oilcloth. Beyond a magical threshold: a chamber with workbench, glass coils, an ANCHOR-marked second door, wet footprints and a hidden unlocked drawer.
defaults.reward: FOUND, NOT YET CLAIMED: three corroded silver sickles, compass, black-glass vial, parchment and potential information in the chamber. Do not add uncollected items to inventory.
defaults.hint: A small tree-covered island rises from the lake.
defaults.notes: CURRENT SCENE: Inside the chamber; Matthael has just cast Revelio. Awaiting the d20 magical-analysis roll. Snaek is with him; the route back toward Fir Isle remains visible. Do not mark CLEARED.
